messages:
ada: heads up — CI spike from the structured-output runner after we merged quantized-v2. lots of schema failures on tool-calls, but manual checks look fine.
kai: can you paste a failing example? is it a validation error or function-name mismatch?
marta: seeing this too. the failures cluster on tests that assert exact function call args (json schema strict). after quantization the model sometimes emits an extra `\n` or escapes differently.
ada: here's one failing log from the CI reporter:
```
expected: {"tool":"lookup_price","args":{"symbol":"AAPL"}}
actual:   {"tool":"lookup_price","args":"{\"symbol\":\"AAPL\"}"}
schema error: args should be object, got string
```
linus: that smells like our postprocessing step in the runner is applying stringify for certain tokens when KV cache alignment differs after quant quantization patch.
eval-bot: [auto] run_id=eval-2026-03-20-42 status=fail metric=schema_pass_rate delta=-12.3%
sanjay: interesting — so the model emitted a JSON-string for args rather than a JSON object. Could be the model's quoting behavior changed or our tokenizer+detokenizer combo changed with the new kernels.
kai: can we reproduce locally with the quantized artifact? steps to repro?
marta: repro steps I used:
1) pull artifacts: `artifact get quantized-v2:20260318`
2) run runner: `python -m eval_runner --suite=toolcall --model=quantized-v2 --strict_schema`
3) check `out/failures/*.json`
I attached one failure file to the CI job.
ada: quick diff of postproc in runner shows a call to `json.loads` wrapped in try-except that falls back to `str` on decoder errors. That fallback was fine for float embeddings but not for structured tool args.
linus: proposed quick fix: remove fallback and surface parsing errors to the CI so we can tell model vs runner. also add a unit test covering nested objects + stringified payloads.
sanjay: agree. also add a reporter metric: `toolcall_parse_mode` (raw/object/stringified) so we can track distribution across models and quant levels.
kai: I've got a tiny patch ready — will submit PR that stops the fallback and alters the runner to emit a parsing hint in the transcript. will also add a migration step in the dashboard to mark the previous failures as runner-induced.
marta: test suggestions: include tests for function calling where `args` is an array vs object vs JSON-string. make the harness assert equality after canonicalization, not raw string compare.
ada: for short-term CI unblocking, can we make the eval job accept `lenient_schema=true` for dedicated quantized-flaky nightly runs so we don't get noisy alerts?
linus: yes but only for nightly. core PR must land to fix strict runs.
kai: PR created: https://git.redwood/eng-ml/runner/pulls/412 — includes unit tests and reporter metric. marking as draft until we add dashboard tile.
sanjay: I'll add an alert rule in Grafana (schema_pass_rate < 90% for strict runs) and a chart for `toolcall_parse_mode`. should help identify model vs runner regressions.
marta: one more note — function-calling canonicalization should preserve `tool` ordering when `ordered=true` in eval spec. don't change that behavior.
ada: great. thanks everyone. I'll queue the PR review and enable lenient nightly runs until fixes land. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: [auto] comment: job=eval-runner-nightly-quantized-v2 link=https://ci.redwood/jobs/12345
kai: merging in 10m if no objections. will tag release v0.43.1 when merged.
